items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Anyway, after that gig ended, this band was rehearsing to go to Hawaii for six weeks, and it was C. P. Johnson. He had the job.

ctx.x: So I told him I wanted to go to California, you know, and to get out of that cold weather. And Roy was coming out in California at that time. I think I mentioned this to you the other day. Roy Eldridge, he had a gig, Billy Berg's -- did I tell you about that?

Well, we spoke about that probably. Anyway, after that gig ended, this band was rehearsing to go to Hawaii for six weeks, and it was C. P. Johnson. He had the job. Gerald Wilson was rehearsing on trumpet, and Gerald called me about going. He says, come on and go. He says, a guy who's supposed to go, the trombone player, his name was Bedsel. He said, he has exams. He was studying to be a dentist, and he
had exams, and he said, just six weeks. Come on and go.
